D2 [BLACK] — OSS-ONLY TEXTURE MEASUREMENT CYCLE / LOCAL PATCH EVIDENCE

MODE = ANALYSIS ONLY
IMAGE GENERATION = NO
IMAGE EDIT/REDRAW OUTPUT = NO
CUSTOM ZORR CODE = NO
CUSTOM GLUE / WRAPPER / SCRIPT FILE = NO
TOOL = ImageMagick 7.1.2-1 Q16-HDRI / mature OSS native CLI only
HEAD BEFORE THIS EVIDENCE COMMENT = `2b0438cb817d41e53bec23944af7237893e12b4b`
BASE MAIN OBSERVED = `b18ca6b9cce2dce6fe304ca8ae36c05df4f4dcb1`

Source integrity:
- C00-A costume/detail = `94c185aea5755e569f8359fd29c6e0b8a1748e1613f2b59e7a3e280205dcbc8e`
- C00-B head yaw = `7646fa2724fd4372eb9811635dbf71bb052151eaf2d4cdb999159124660a16d1`
- C00-C master front = `57fbec5d9c136a90c6ac262f8011665fa061dca427bf3fb2c3f110d1cb0a69ed`
- C00-D body turnaround = `49f1c5fa9973f185c4ed7441325e2705d392449f6d59b4592ec6d81bc4b4da82`
- current neon/key-visual transfer sample = `9f31935946de0559a4c74b9c35b463125caa54df1438b4406eccb47f8b58c905`

Native ImageMagick operations used read-only to `info:`: crop, Gray colorspace, built-in entropy/statistics, built-in Canny `0x1+10%+30%`, built-in Gaussian blur `0x1.2` + Difference composite. No image file was written by the measurement operations.

IMPORTANT LIMIT: these rectangular patches are LOCAL PROBES, NOT semantic material masks. They support comparative direction only and MUST NOT be promoted into per-material numeric canon envelopes.

## Probe A — ivory cloth scale collapse
C00-A close/detail, calm back-coat patch `70x100+810+290`:
- entropy = `0.323355`
- Canny occupancy = `0.0584286`
- fine residual mean = `0.00861839`

C00-D full-body/back, calm coat patch `50x90+1390+220`:
- entropy = `0.272426`
- Canny occupancy = `0.0400000`
- fine residual mean = `0.00325392`

Directional result:
- fine residual falls by about 62% from the close/detail sample to the full-body sample;
- Canny occupancy falls by about 32%;
- entropy also falls.

This directly supports the existing #199 distance law and current model that calm ivory tailoring spends a smaller texture budget at full-body scale.

## Probe B — unseen neon skin transfer vs base close skin
C00-A base close skin patch `60x45+250+120`:
- entropy = `0.454794`
- Canny occupancy = `0.114074`
- fine residual mean = `0.0216751`

Neon/key-visual forehead patch `120x80+445+260`:
- entropy = `0.492475`
- Canny occupancy = `0.233125`
- fine residual mean = `0.0300478`

Directional result:
- Canny occupancy is about 2.0x the base close-skin sample;
- fine residual is about 39% higher;
- entropy is higher.

This supports the prior visual verdict that the neon treatment is a useful COLOR/LIGHT key-visual experiment but is too texture-dense to become the base skin rendering standard.

## Probe C — neon ivory can become noisier even when hard edges do not rise
Base C00-A calm ivory patch:
- entropy = `0.323355`
- Canny occupancy = `0.0584286`
- fine residual mean = `0.00861839`

Neon/key-visual ivory shoulder patch `140x120+90+900`:
- entropy = `0.471737`
- Canny occupancy = `0.036131`
- fine residual mean = `0.0134414`

Directional result:
- fine residual rises by about 56%;
- entropy rises by about 46%;
- Canny occupancy does NOT rise.

New learning: `EDGE DENSITY ALONE != TEXTURE DENSITY`. Broad grain/paint/stipple information can increase high-frequency/entropy while not producing more strong Canny edges. Therefore #199 texture QC must remain multi-signal: structural edges and fine-frequency/noise behavior must not be collapsed into one metric.

## Probe D — leather differs from calm cloth
C00-A close shoe local patch:
- Canny occupancy = `0.0866667`
- fine residual mean = `0.015558`

C00-C full-body shoe local patch:
- Canny occupancy = `0.0800000`
- fine residual mean = `0.0160701`

This local probe does NOT show the same strong collapse as calm ivory cloth. Directionally this supports `TEXTURE = SCALE_BUDGET x MATERIAL_RESPONSE`: specular leather may preserve a small number of high-contrast highlight structures even when cloth micro-information collapses. Because the rectangles are not semantic masks, no numeric leather law is claimed.

## Current learning delta

SUPPORTED:
`TEXTURE = SCALE_BUDGET x MATERIAL_RESPONSE`

SUPPORTED:
`IVORY / CALM CLOTH -> strong microdetail collapse with distance`

SUPPORTED:
`LEATHER / SPECULAR MATERIAL -> selected high-contrast structure may survive farther than calm cloth microtexture`

SUPPORTED:
`EDGE DENSITY ALONE IS INSUFFICIENT FOR TEXTURE QC`

SUPPORTED:
`NEON KEY-VISUAL = COLOR/LIGHT REFERENCE; NOT BASE TEXTURE AUTHORITY`

NOT PROVEN:
- per-material numeric PASS envelopes;
- semantic material masks from current OSS path;
- TEXTURE_LANGUAGE_R01 terminal PASS.

BLOCKER remains bounded: installed ImageMagick provides mature native image statistics/edge/frequency primitives but not semantic understanding of skin/hair/cloth/leather. Building a custom semantic extractor is forbidden. Until a mature OSS native semantic path is physically available, `PER_MATERIAL_SEMANTIC_NUMERIC_QC = OSS_CAPABILITY_NOT_AVAILABLE / CUSTOM_CODE_FORBIDDEN`.

NEXT LEGAL ACTION = continue OSS-only analysis of existing sources, focusing on scale-transfer and material-specific qualitative routing; no new code, no generated images.

Authority: #199 character drawing law; #201 visual taboo; #206 hard open-code law.

## OPEN CODE REUSED
Minimal glue around pinned open-source stack already present on this branch:
- numpy==2.3.5
- opencv-python-headless==4.14.0.94
- checkout action pinned by commit

No custom framework introduced.

## R01 ABSOLUTE ANCHOR QC
Existing R01 remains intact:
- 4..6 dominant tone bands
- strong-edge density 0.08..0.14
- deep ink <0.05 in the intended face/skin measurement domain
- line hierarchy ratio >=4.0
- high-frequency Laplacian variance <=800

R01 absolute thresholds are not weakened by R02.

## R02 SEMANTIC REGION QC
Fresh audit found that whole-component measurement can mix face/skin with Character Truth black masses such as hair, shirt, and accessories.

Implemented:
- legacy analyze_image_bgr() retained;
- analyze_region_bgr(image, region_mask) added;
- semantic identity mask is supplied upstream, not inferred from color in QC;
- empty/mismatched masks fail closed.

Absolute anchor QC and cross-view transfer QC are separate domains.
